assembly_notes: One-handed garden pruner. A small rigid pivot_frame root carries the main pivot boss, its bolt head and captive nut. The cutting_half and the counter_half are both REVOLUTE children of that frame on the same main axis, opening symmetrically by open_angle_rad each; q=0 is fully closed. head_build changes the jaw pair only (bypass_blade, hooked_beak, long_bypass, anvil_insert) and handle_build changes how both handles are built behind the pivot (sculpted_grip, plate_frame); the two are independent because the jaw and the handle meet at a fixed tang section at the pivot. return_build is the spring that reopens the jaws: coil_seat runs on a PRISMATIC seat between the handles, torsion_coil wraps the pivot on its own revolute leg, and leaf_spring bows between them. spring_stage_count stacks that spring along its own axis. catch_build is the locking hardware on the counter handle: swing_latch, thumb_slider (prismatic), ratchet_pawl, stop_screw (prismatic) and rotating_sleeve. Every catch mounts at the same station on the counter handle and stays within the handle envelope at every pose, so all combinations build. tool_length_m, jaw_ratio and open_angle_rad are the independent parameters; palette and grip ribbing are non-core.
